Compare a recomputed region map against a published one

Source: R/region_map.R
rgnmapcmp.Rd

Matches two region maps on the unit identifier and compares the named columns cell by cell, reporting for each column how many cells disagree and the first disagreement. Use it to confirm that a region map rebuilt from the boundary file (for example with rgnmappts()) reproduces the one that was published or pinned.

Usage

rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, unit, cols = NULL)

Arguments

pub

The region map as published (a data frame).

obs

The region map as recomputed (a data frame).

unit

Name of the unit identifier column, present in both.

cols

Character vector of columns to compare. NULL (the default) compares every column the two share apart from unit.

Value

A data frame, one row per compared column plus a first "rows" row for units present on one side only, with columns column (character), cells (integer: for "rows" the number of distinct units on either side, otherwise the number of shared units compared), mismatched (integer) and first (character, the first disagreement written out as text, "" when none). Zero mismatched throughout is the passing result.

Details

Units are matched by their identifier as text with spaces trimmed; when an identifier repeats, its first row is used. Numeric columns are compared with all.equal() at its default tolerance (relative \(1.5 \times 10^{-8}\)), so a coordinate that survived a round trip through text is not reported as a change; everything else is compared exactly as text after trimming whitespace. Two missing values agree; a missing value against a present one disagrees.

What this establishes is that the recomputation reproduced the published assignment. It does NOT establish that the assignment is right: run the same method against the same boundary file and a definitional error reproduces perfectly. That is what rgnmapalt() is for.

Errors: either input not a data frame or without unit; a column in cols that is not in both.

See also

rgnmapalt(), rgnmapintg()

Examples

pub <- data.frame(
  inst = c("North Jail", "South Jail"),
  cd = c("3557", "3520"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
obs <- pub
rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, "inst")
#>   column cells mismatched first
#> 1   rows     2          0      
#> 2     cd     2          0      

# a changed assignment is reported with the unit that moved
obs$cd[2] <- "3521"
rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, "inst")
#>   column cells mismatched                                       first
#> 1   rows     2          0                                            
#> 2     cd     2          1 South Jail: published 3520, recomputed 3521

# a unit on one side only, and a coordinate that only moved by rounding noise
pub$lat <- c(44.39, 43.65)
obs2 <- data.frame(inst = c("North Jail", "Hill Jail"), cd = c("3557", "3506"),
                   lat = c(44.39 + 1e-12, 45.1))
rgnmapcmp(pub, obs2, "inst", cols = c("cd", "lat"))
#>   column cells mismatched                      first
#> 1   rows     3          2 published only: South Jail
#> 2     cd     1          0                           
#> 3    lat     1          0                           

# a compared column must be in both maps
try(rgnmapcmp(pub, obs, "inst", cols = "lat"))
#> Error : both frames need the compared columns; missing: lat
